title: Mercy of God
definition: The mercy of God is His compassion toward the guilty, weak, suffering, needy, and undeserving.
summary: God's mercy meets people in sin and suffering. He withholds deserved judgment, gives help in weakness, and provides forgiveness through Christ.
christFocus: Through Christ, God shows mercy by forgiving sinners, restoring the broken, and drawing near to the needy.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's mercy meets people in sin and suffering. He withholds deserved judgment, gives help in weakness, and provides forgiveness through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
